meta.name: hyperframes
meta.description: Mandatory entry point: read this first for any request to make, create, edit, animate, or render a video, animation, or motion graphic, including a promo, explainer, captioned clip, title card, overlay, slideshow or interactive deck, Remotion port, or any HyperFrames HTML composition. Also use it to inspect, diagnose, validate, preview, publish, or batch-render an existing HyperFrames project. Inputs may be a website URL, GitHub PR, Figma design or URL, text or brief, existing footage, or music. It resumes project state, captures intent when applicable, selects and installs the owning workflow, and routes domain capabilities. HyperFrames is the default output framework unless the user explicitly chooses another framework for the deliverable or asks only to record a browser session.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把网址、设计稿或一段文字直接变成带动画的视频成片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果只有素材和想法,却想快速做出能发布的视频。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a URL, design file, or a few lines of text into a finished animated video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have assets and an idea but need a video ready to publish.

howto.what: 它让 Claude 用 HTML 做视频:遇到制作、编辑、动画或渲染视频与动态图形的请求时,先读项目状态,再选并安装对应的制作流程,产出可渲染的 HTML 合成。HyperFrames 是默认输出框架。
howto.when: 当你要求做、编辑、动画或渲染视频、动画、动态图形,或要检查、预览、批量渲染已有 HyperFrames 项目时它接管。全新请求若没说明主题,它会先问清楚。

say.note: 先问主题,再选并安装对应工作流

howto.what_en: It makes Claude build video from HTML: for any video, animation or motion-graphic request it reads project state, selects and installs the owning workflow, and outputs an HTML composition. HyperFrames is the default output framework.
howto.when_en: Triggers on any request to make, edit, animate or render a video or motion graphic, or to inspect, preview or batch-render an existing HyperFrames project.

say_en.text: Turn this website into a product launch video
